t1_email.subject: Your coffee is still in your cart
t1_email.preheader: We kept it exactly as you left it
t1_email.headline: Still thinking it over?
paragraphs: Hi {first_name}, you left {item_name} in your cart. We saved it, so you can finish checking out whenever you are ready.
Every bag ships with its roast date on the label, so you will know exactly how fresh it is when it arrives.
t1_email.hypothesis: Showing the saved cart with one button recovers more checkouts than a generic reminder; falsified if B recovers as many or more within 72 hours.

t1_email.subject: Still in your cart: {item_name}
t1_email.preheader: Pick up right where you stopped
t1_email.headline: Your cart is saved
paragraphs: Hi {first_name}, your cart at {product_name} is still here, with {item_name} in it.
If something stopped you at checkout, reply to this email and a person on our team will help.
t1_email.hypothesis: Naming the item in the subject line lifts opens and recovery; falsified if A recovers as many or more within 72 hours.

t2_sms.text: Not sure which grind to pick? Reply with how you brew and we will tell you.
t2_sms.hypothesis: Answering the grind question by text removes the most common coffee-specific hesitation; falsified if B recovers as many or more.

t2_sms.text: Shipping shows at checkout before you pay, so there are no surprises. Your cart:
t2_sms.hypothesis: Naming when shipping cost appears answers the cost worry; falsified if A recovers as many or more.

t2_email_fallback.subject: Which grind should you choose?
t2_email_fallback.preheader: Tell us how you brew and we will tell you
t2_email_fallback.headline: The right grind for how you brew
paragraphs: Hi {first_name}, the question we hear most at checkout is which grind to choose. Whole bean keeps longest if you have a grinder; otherwise pick the grind for your brewer: coarse for a French press, medium for drip, fine for espresso.
Not sure? Reply with how you make your coffee and a person on our team will tell you which to pick. Your cart is saved in the meantime.
t2_email_fallback.hypothesis: A concrete grind answer converts people who stopped over the choice; falsified if B recovers as many or more within 72 hours.

t2_email_fallback.subject: No surprises at checkout
t2_email_fallback.headline: See the full price before you pay
paragraphs: Hi {first_name}, if you stopped because you were not sure what shipping would cost, the checkout page shows it before you enter any payment details.
Your cart is saved with {item_name} in it, and questions about an order go straight to a person on our team if you reply to this email.
t2_email_fallback.hypothesis: Saying where shipping cost appears answers the most common cost worry; falsified if A recovers as many or more within 72 hours.

t3_email.subject: Last reminder about your cart
t3_email.preheader: It is saved, if you still want it
t3_email.headline: One last note about your cart
paragraphs: Hi {first_name}, this is the last reminder from us about the coffee in your cart. It is saved if you want to finish your order.
If now is not the right time, that is fine. You will not hear from us about this cart again.
t3_email.hypothesis: A short, honest last note recovers late buyers without an offer; falsified if B recovers as many or more within 7 days.

t3_email.subject: Still want {item_name}?
t3_email.preheader: Your cart is saved for you
t3_email.headline: Your cart is still here
paragraphs: Hi {first_name}, we will not keep reminding you, but your cart is still saved at {product_name} if you want it.
If you have a question before you order, reply and a person on our team will answer.
t3_email.hypothesis: Naming the item one last time recovers more than a generic note; falsified if A recovers as many or more within 7 days.
